caption: The drawing shows a single glass pitcher centrally placed on a plain beige background. The pitcher is predominantly red, with a textured, diamond-patterned surface on the lower half and a smooth upper half. The rim of the pitcher is scalloped with rounded, wavy edges. The handle, attached to the right side, is semi-transparent and features a mix of pale greenish and pink hues. The spout on the upper left side is slightly pronounced. The overall shape of the pitcher is rounded, tapering slightly toward the base, and the drawing is composed with detailed highlights and shadows to indicate the reflective nature of the glass material.
title: Pitcher
